name: Contact | Wild Lake Studio
description: Tell Wild-Lake about your work and the support you need. Optional prompts for artists, labels, galleries, agencies and institutions.
headline: Let’s begin.

hasPart.name: Let’s begin.
hasPart.text: NEW YORK / TAMPA / SANTIAGO / WORLDWIDE. Tell us about your work, or the artists you work with, and the support you are looking for. info@wildlakestudio.com

hasPart.name: A place to start
hasPart.text: These prompts are optional. Answer the ones that help, skip the rest. If you are an artist: What are you making, and where is it now? Where does the work meet friction? What would the next year look like if it went well? If you represent a label, gallery, agency or institution: Which artist or program is this about? What is the situation, and what is the timeline? What do you want the studio to do? Include if you can: A link to the work. Your name. This form opens an email draft for you to review and send. You can also write to us directly at info@wildlakestudio.com. Your work stays yours. We never take ownership or a percentage.
